messages:
Maria G: quick q — where can I find the region health dashboard for eu-west and model-serving latency? I tried the usual dashboards but I get a 403 when opening the link.
Raj P: That should be in Grafana under Observability -> Dashboards -> Region Overview. Try this: https://grafana.redwood-inference.internal/d/region-overview?var-region=eu-west
Maria G: 403 on that link too :/ looks like I don't have the grafana-viewers group.
Luke: @Maria G I added you to grafana-viewers a minute ago, but SSO can take a few mins to sync.
Maria G: still 403 after 5m, maybe SSO not synced for our org.
Raj P: If SSO hasn't propagated, infra can kick a manual sync. @Katie (infra) can you run an SSO sync for eng-runtime org?
Katie (infra): kicking off a manual SSO sync now. I'll post when it's done. :white_check_mark:
observability-bot: SSO sync started (job_id=sso-sync-9042)
Katie (infra): sync finished, granted grafana-viewers to maria.g@redwood-inference.com — try the link again.
Maria G: can access now, thanks! Found the latency panels under "Model Serving -> Region KPIs" and the traces link goes to Tempo.
Maria G: one follow-up — the alert "model-latency-eu" has been firing a lot during the retrofit experiments. Looks noisy. Where should we request tuning or temporary mutes?
Raj P: For tuning, open an eng-sre ticket with the sample window and expected SLO. For immediate relief I can mute the alert for eu cluster for a short window. @Luke, do you approve a 2h mute?
Luke: approve 2h mute for eu cluster while Maria investigates.
Raj P: done — muted alert model-latency-eu for eu-west until 1754336200. I updated the alert runbook with notes about experiment-related traffic.
Maria G: perfect, that buys us time. I'll file a tuning request with the metrics and a suggested new threshold. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
